name: cache-guard
description: Warns before a cold prompt cache re-bills the whole context, and shows the cache and subagent state on the status line

gateUsd.title: Ask above (USD)
gateUsd.description: Ask before sending to a cold cache when re-writing the context would cost at least this much at API prices.

ttlMinutes.title: Assumed cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache is assumed to live when a response does not report its cache lifetime (a proxy may not); hits and misses on such responses adjust it. Set 60 for a proxy configured for the 1-hour cache.

agentTtlMinutes.title: Assumed subagent cache lifetime (minutes)
agentTtlMinutes.description: How long a subagent's prompt cache is assumed to live when a response does not report its cache lifetime; hits and misses on such responses adjust it.
